title: AI-Powered Math Teaching Assistant - Process-level Feedback & Assessment
summary: ZEZEDU reports academic improvement after one month of CherryPot use across Korean schools. The chapter gives no effect size or independent outcome evaluation.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: ZEZEDU reports academic improvement after one month of CherryPot use across Korean schools. The chapter gives no effect size or independent outcome evaluation. Deployed across schools / scaling. The chapter reports the stated benefit but does not independently verify it.
purpose: Provide process-level math feedback and automate grading.

ratings.reason: The provider reports academic improvement after one month of use. This is a claimed learning-result improvement, although no effect size or independent evaluation is supplied.
The deployed platform automates grading and process-level feedback, which the provider presents as reducing teachers' routine work. The time saving is unquantified.

ai_role.statement: The chapter describes this system as supporting the stated purpose. Its causal contribution to the benefit has not been separately assessed.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use case 1: AI-Powered Math Teaching Assistant - Process-level Feedback & Assessment
